svg.aria-label: Two routes to the pixel size and ellipse. calibrate, for many orientations, matches the maxima of the radial peak histogram to the allowed ring radii by position only. calibrate_2d, for one dominant orientation, sums the peaks into a 2D spot pattern, indexes it, and fits a 2 by 2 distortion to the paired spots
svg.font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
